qa_pairs.question: How has the duty-free Passenger Baggage Allowance for airline crew evolved in comparison to the stable allowance for maritime sailors between 2012 and 2025?
qa_pairs.answer: According to the shared clauses, the airline crew's Passenger Baggage Allowance was $100 in 2012 [0], increased to $300 by 2016 [1], remained at $300 through 2023 [2] and 2024 [3], and was finally reduced to $150 in 2025 [4]. In contrast, the allowance for maritime sailors (bedding) has remained stable at $300 throughout this period.
